acceptance.state: Fixtures only; photographic and numerical acceptance remain pending
acceptance.intendedUse: Native portrait skin/hair review and manual single-image denoise/detail/enlargement verification at low and high recorded ISO.
limitations: Embedded JPEGs were used only for content selection; they cannot stand in for native RAW detail.
The photographs are not a matched clean/noisy pair or radiometric ground truth.
ISO is recorded metadata, not an automatic noise estimate.
No real starfield is provided by this set.
These fixtures do not enable an application demo or automatic import.
